info.title: CortexCloud Optimization Network
info.description: Optimization infrastructure for AI agents — discover, pay for, and execute classical, hybrid, or quantum optimization through a single API.
info.x-guidance: CortexCloud — optimization infrastructure for AI agents. Discover, pay for, and execute classical, hybrid, or quantum optimization through a single API. POST /v1/estimate is free. POST /v1/optimize returns HTTP 402 with an x402 PaymentRequirements challenge (USDC on Base, chain 8453). Sign the challenge with your wallet and resend with the payment-signature header. Poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}. No API keys, no subscriptions.
